snippet.title: Broken History
snippet.description:
Broken History — The Chronicle of Great Failures.

History isn’t just written by the victors; it’s shaped by the scars of hubris, incompetence, and fatal mistakes.

On this channel, we dissect history's most catastrophic military fiascos, analyze the collapse of mighty empires, and examine the kings whose blind ambitions led to absolute ruin. Why did "invincible" armies turn to dust? How did a single misunderstood order wipe entire regiments off the map?

What to expect:

Anatomy of Disaster: Deep dives into the tactical and strategic blunders that shattered nations.

The Ego of Rulers: How the pride and arrogance of monarchs became a death sentence for their people.

Dark Graphic Style: History brought to life with a gritty, dark comic aesthetic — focusing on the shadows, the fatalism, and the grim reality of war.

Welcome to the breaking point. Welcome to Broken History.

snippet.title: Chronicles of Medieval History
snippet.description:
Step into the dark heart of history.
On The Cruelest And The bloodiest medieval life, we uncover the most savage, brutal, and bizarre events of the medieval world. From sadistic kings and ruthless knights, to bloody wars, torture devices, and forgotten massacres, this channel reveals the cruel realities of the Middle Ages like you’ve never seen before.

⚔️ Medieval executions, dark rituals, bizarre laws, and twisted betrayals—every episode dives deep into the shocking truth behind real historical events that shaped kingdoms and cost thousands of lives.

We answer chilling questions like:

What was the most painful medieval torture method?

Who were the most ruthless rulers in history?

What dark secrets did knights hide beneath their armor?

How did medieval wars truly end—and at what cost?


Perfect for fans of medieval history, true crime, ancient warfare, and the brutal past of kings and empires, our cinematic storytelling brings forgotten horrors to life.

snippet.title: Swords & Scrolls
snippet.description:
Swords & Scrolls is a YouTube channel dedicated to the history of the Islamic world — from the earliest battles that shaped civilisations, to the scholars, caliphs, and conquerors who built empires spanning three continents.

Every week, we bring you cinematic, story-driven episodes covering Islamic military history, the Islamic Golden Age, the rise and fall of great caliphates, and the forgotten figures who changed the world. Whether it's the Battle of Badr, the House of Wisdom in Baghdad, the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople, or the Mali Empire at its peak — we go deep, we go visual, and we make history feel alive.

This channel is for anyone who loves history — Muslim or not. If you've ever wondered why so much of the modern world traces back to the 7th–16th centuries of the Islamic world, you're in the right place.

New episodes every week. Subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss a story.

Join our community of history enthusiasts and discover the fascinating world of military history with Kings and Generals.

snippet.title: Real Crusades History
snippet.description:
Real Crusades History is a channel dedicated to the history of the Middle Ages. Explore the Viking age in England, the Normans and their adventures across the Mediterranean, the rise of Arab Spain, the epic battles of the Reconquista, the fascinating events of the Crusades, the amazing campaigns of the Ottoman Turks, and much more.

J. Stephen Roberts, who has been featured on the History Channel's History's Greatest Mysteries, will be your guide on this amazing journey. Be sure to check out J Stephen's historical novel, Why Does the Heathen Rage?, which chronicles events of the Crusades from 1223 to 1225.

If you like these videos, please consider making a donation via the Patreon link below. snippet.title: History Dose
snippet.description:
Two brothers, Chris the history grad and Joe the artist, team up to capture the wonder, terror, and beauty of the past. Chris holds a B.A. with honors in history from Cornell University (2018). He writes and narrates each script and posts a bibliography of academic sources in each video description, including fully footnoted scripts so that interested viewers may source specific claims and learn more. Joe is a digital artist who manually creates each piece with a stylus and pad, honing his craft in the medium since 2017. Together, we are History Dose®. 

If our content clicks with you, please consider making a pledge at our Patreon. Every dollar helps, and memberships give you access to certain rewards: bonus episodes, behind-the-scenes interactions, Discord access and more.
https://www.patreon.com/historydose

snippet.title: Timeline History
snippet.description:
Welcome to Timeline History, where the past is brought to life.
Our mission is to create an authentic and visually immersive educational experience. We combine meticulous historical research with cutting-edge visualization tools to build cinematic narratives that transport you back in time.
Every scene, from the armor of a medieval knight to the architecture of ancient Rome, is crafted based on historical records, archaeological evidence, and academic accounts. Our team of historians and artists uses this research to direct powerful digital tools, allowing us to reconstruct the past in breathtaking detail.
While the visuals are modern creations, the stories, facts, and human experiences we explore are entirely rooted in real history. We don't just tell you about history; we show it to you. Join us on a journey through time.

snippet.title: Empire in Ashes
snippet.description:
Empire in Ashes is a cinematic historical documentary channel dedicated to the rise and fall of the world’s most powerful empires, kingdoms, and civilizations.

We explore the stories behind legendary rulers, devastating wars, political betrayals, lost dynasties, ancient mysteries, collapsing kingdoms, and the turning points that changed human history forever. From Rome, Persia, and the Ottomans to forgotten realms buried beneath time, our documentaries uncover how power was built, how it was challenged, and how it ultimately turned to ashes.

If you are passionate about history, ancient civilizations, military conflicts, fallen empires, and dark historical storytelling, Empire in Ashes delivers gripping documentaries designed for a global audience.

Subscribe for premium history documentaries, cinematic storytelling, and the forgotten truths of the past.
